updates.title: Personal cameras
updates.body: Add a compatible camera with setup options for 22 brands, or connect a Reolink camera using your own UID and password. When adding another camera, search for an existing group or create a new one.

updates.title: Live view & recordings
updates.body: Take a snapshot or record a clip while watching live. Captures stay in AirTracker until you choose to download a copy. Open Saved captures to swipe through photos and videos in fullscreen.

updates.title: Smoother camera refreshes
updates.body: The current photo stays visible until the next one is ready, then fades smoothly into the new image. You’ll see this in Live Cameras and fullscreen previews. New Archive photos also fade into place.

updates.title: Liquid Glass
updates.body: A smaller preview and slimmer sliders make settings easier to use on smaller phones. What’s New stays within reach. In Briefing and Camera Archive, glass controls join more smoothly, and only the control you touch lights up.

updates.title: Classic theme
updates.body: Classic now uses a black background in dark mode and white in light mode, with clearer text and controls.

previous.title: A smoother AirTracker, with more to explore

updates.title: Improvements
updates.body: Smoother scrolling, cleaner transitions, refined glass controls and more consistent colours across the app.

updates.title: Flights
updates.body: A new liquid pull-to-refresh effect, steadier loading and smoother card updates. Hide several landed flights and bring them all back with one Undo.

updates.title: Live cameras
updates.body: A compact camera grid, smoother photo refreshes and improved fullscreen controls. Add and group your own camera links with our experimental personal cameras feature.

updates.title: Camera archive
updates.body: Browse saved photos from the past 28 hours, search by time and easily see photo counts and storage used.

updates.title: Uber at JAC
updates.body: Plan airport pickups with upcoming arrivals and camera views. Quickly open Uber for a ride or Uber Driver if you’re driving.

updates.title: Recovery & updates
updates.body: A simpler recovery screen with access to previous app versions when you need them.

previous.title: A clearer view of your flights

updates.title: Flights
updates.body: Clearer gate details and a simpler header without the background photo make flight information easier to read.

updates.title: Search & filters
updates.body: One floating glass control brings search and filters together. Cleaner page titles make more room for your flights.

updates.title: Landed flights
updates.body: Swipe left to reveal Hide, with a soft click and light vibration. Hidden flights appear in the existing Hide arrived count. Changed your mind? Tap Undo in the glass bar above the bottom navigation.

updates.title: Refresh glow
updates.body: A brighter, colourful glow moves softly around flight cards as they refresh.

updates.title: Welcome
updates.body: New graphite, bronze and navy wallpapers, with a cleaner look and no pagination dots.

previous.title: A new home for your data

updates.title: A new home for your data
updates.body: We’re excited to share that we’ve moved to a new database for your account, notes and files. Update the app to stay connected. If anything seems missing or isn’t working, please let us know through Feedback.

updates.title: Notes
updates.body: Keep photos, recordings and videos with your notes. Deleting a note also removes its attachments.

updates.title: Profile
updates.body: See your name, birthday, bio and email together, with editing and security options in the menu.

updates.title: Password recovery
updates.body: Clearer steps, a Copy password option and an easy return to the app.

updates.title: Flights
updates.body: Updates continue until 1:30 AM Jackson time, with more complete details for United flights operated by SkyWest.

updates.title: Settings
updates.body: Keep Arrivals and Departures on screen with one Always On setting. Press and hold supported settings for helpful animated previews.
